finding: Dadao/KMT war with CCP neutral is source-supported during the Chinese Truce; use KMT initiating the war so no controller-created new war is needed.

legal_sequence.step: Japan creates Dadao by influence before invading China.
Japan later declares war on China; CCP/KMT agree to the Chinese Truce. Japan stays at peace with all Major Powers, so Dadao remains separately controlled.

KMT attacks Dadao, which possesses Chinese Home Country land. The minor-KMT declaration condition permits this, and the Dadao ability expressly anticipates KMT attacking without Dadao aligning with Japan.
Dadao retaliates against KMT as a controlled minor already at war. CCP has not declared war and does not inherit KMT external wars merely by signing the Truce.
CCP co-occupants not at war with Dadao do not join defense and must relocate if Dadao conquers the land.

landless_CCP: CCP never surrenders (CCP NRS p1); the civil war ends for absence of surviving units, not absence of territory (RB14.3 p101).
limits: Political legality established from source; this is not a generated complete campaign trace. The no-Friendly-destination case additionally requires no CCP land or remaining Friendly KMT destination.
ruling_status: No adoption or gameplay change. The no-destination consequence in RCL-015 remains open; no elimination rule has been adopted.
independent_source_review: Complete relevant source pages visually inspected; no contrary automatic war coupling found.
